title: Royal New Zealand Air Force aerial reconnaissance of Christchurch earthquake damage, 2011
credit: New Zealand Defence Force (RNZAF), Crown Copyright 2011; CC BY 2.0
altText: Aerial reconnaissance image taken by an RNZAF P-3K Orion showing earthquake damage near New Brighton Road, Pages Road, Hawke Street and Owles Terrace, Christchurch.
caption: Aerial reconnaissance image taken by an RNZAF P-3K Orion showing earthquake damage near New Brighton Road, Pages Road, Hawke Street and Owles Terrace, Christchurch.
context: Contemporary NZDF aerial surveillance of the Christchurch earthquake damage on 22 February 2011; documents response imagery, not the subsequent web mapping application.
derivativesNote: Original unchanged JPEG preserved in NZ GIS History Research Packages / Wave 3 archive; the website serves uncropped 1600px and 720px WebP derivatives.
